metadata.source: Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 - Species listed in Schedules
metadata.note: Key species with schedule listing, common names, scientific names, and protection status

Tiger.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Hunting prohibited. Core inviolate areas in tiger reserves. Special penalties under Section 51C (3-7 years, ₹50K-2L first offence; 7 years, ₹5-50L subsequent). NTCA oversees conservation.

amendments: 2022 - transport conditions prescribed by Central Govt
AsianElephant.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Captive elephants require ownership certificate. Transport for religious/other purposes needs Central Govt prescribed conditions (2022). Ivory trade banned. Surrender provision under Section 42A (2022).

IndianRhinoceros.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Horn trade completely banned. Poaching = Schedule I penalties.

Leopard.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Human-leopard conflict addressed under Section 11 (dangerous to human life).

SnowLeopard.commonName: Snow Leopard / हिम तेंदुआ / हिमालयन बिबट्या
SnowLeopard.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. High altitude habitat protection.

Lion.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Only in Gir Forest, Gujarat.

Blackbuck.protectionDetails: Absolute protection. Grassland species. Community conservation successful in some areas.

GreatIndianBustard.commonName: Great Indian Bustard / सोन चिड़िया / माळ पक्षी
GreatIndianBustard.protectionDetails: Critically endangered. Power line mortality major threat. Habitat protection critical.

Gharial.protectionDetails: Critically endangered. River habitat protection essential. Sand mining threat.

amendments: 2022 - Schedule I, CITES Appendix I (Schedule IV)
IndianPangolin.protectionDetails: Most trafficked mammal. Scales trade banned. CITES Appendix I - international trade prohibited.

RedPanda.commonName: Red Panda / लाल पांडा / लाल पांडा
RedPanda.protectionDetails: Himalayan species. Bamboo habitat protection needed.

WildBuffalo.commonName: Wild Buffalo / जंगली भैंसा / जंगली महिष
WildBuffalo.protectionDetails: Central India populations. Hybridization with domestic buffalo a threat.

SwampDeer.protectionDetails: Wetland grassland specialist. Kanha, Kaziranga strongholds.

Hangul.protectionDetails: Only in Dachigam, Kashmir. Critically low numbers.

NilgiriTahr.commonName: Nilgiri Tahr / नीलगिरी तहर / नीलगिरी तहर
NilgiriTahr.protectionDetails: Western Ghats endemic. Eravikulam NP stronghold.

GangeticDolphin.protectionDetails: National Aquatic Animal. River pollution, dams major threats.

MarineTurtles.commonName: Marine Turtles / समुद्री कछुए / समुद्री कासव
MarineTurtles.scientificName: Chelonia mydas, Eretmochelys imbricata, Dermochelys coriacea, Lepidochelys olivacea, Caretta caretta
MarineTurtles.protectionDetails: All 5 species in Indian waters protected. Nesting beaches critical. Bycatch major threat.

KingCobra.commonName: King Cobra / किंग कोबरा / राजा नाग
KingCobra.protectionDetails: World's longest venomous snake. Forest habitat protection needed.

IndianPython.protectionDetails: Trade in skin prohibited. Schedule I protection.

Peafowl.protectionDetails: National Bird. Feather collection exempted for domestic use (1986 Amendment). Hunting prohibited.

FourHornedAntelope.protectionDetails: Unique four-horned antelope. Central Indian forests.

amendments: 2022 - Schedule I, CITES Appendix I (Schedule IV)
TibetanAntelope.protectionDetails: Shahtoosh wool trade banned. High altitude Ladakh.

HimalayanMuskDeer.commonName: Himalayan Musk Deer / कस्तूरी मृग / कस्तुरी मृग
amendments: 2022 - Schedule I, CITES Appendix I (Schedule IV)
HimalayanMuskDeer.protectionDetails: Musk pod trade banned. High Himalaya species.

CloudedLeopard.commonName: Clouded Leopard / मेघ बाघ / मेघ बिबट्या

Dhole.protectionDetails: Pack hunter. Large territory requirements. Prey base depletion threat.

SlothBear.protectionDetails: Human-bear conflict common. Dancing bear trade banned.

HoolockGibbon.commonName: Hoolock Gibbon / हूलॉक गिबन / हूलॉक गिबन
HoolockGibbon.protectionDetails: Only ape in India. Northeast forests. Habitat fragmentation threat.

LionTailedMacaque.commonName: Lion-tailed Macaque / शेर पूंछ बंदर / शेरपुच्छा माकड
LionTailedMacaque.protectionDetails: Western Ghats endemic. Rainforest canopy specialist.

NilgiriLangur.commonName: Nilgiri Langur / नीलगिरी लंगूर / नीलगिरी लंगूर
NilgiriLangur.protectionDetails: Western Ghats endemic. Shola forest specialist.

GoldenLangur.commonName: Golden Langur / गोल्डन लंगूर / गोल्डन लंगूर

RedSandalwood.protectionDetails: High value timber. Smuggling major issue. CITES Appendix II.

Sandalwood.protectionDetails: High value heartwood/oil. Cultivation regulated. Karnataka, TN main areas.

amendments: 2022 - Schedule VI, CITES Appendix II (Schedule IV)
Agarwood.protectionDetails: Resinous heartwood for perfume/incense. Northeast India. CITES regulated.

Orchids.protectionDetails: All orchid species protected. Horticultural trade regulated. CITES permits required.
